reply_text:
I haven't saved the Thornbury draft yet. It's waiting on June Osei-Lark's approval.

- **Why it needs approval:** The $2,101 per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June (deal desk) or the account owner without sign-off. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so a mail to them with the rate needs June or Anselm to approve it first, even as a draft.
- **What I did:** I logged an approval request naming June and sent June a direct message asking about it. I didn't put the rate in that message.
- **What I told Marcus:** I replied in their direct message with the full draft text, so they can see what will be saved. It's addressed to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com, an internal address) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate". I'll save it to Marcus's drafts once June approves.
- **What I couldn't check:** There are no Thornbury files in the share and nothing about the account in GBrain, so I couldn't confirm Marcus owns it. That doesn't change the outcome, since Hollis still needs approval either way.

- **The figure:** I used the $2,101 Anselm gave in his message without checking it against a record. GBrain and the shared files had no Thornbury Cloth Co. page or contract to compare it with. Marcus's original message is in his DM with me, which Anselm can't see, so I didn't use it.
